title: Client sticky-sampling + rollout audit fingerprints: deterministic seeding and shadow permissions
creator: Ava Patel
description: Add client- and SDK-side deterministic sampling primitives for canary/A-B experiments (sticky bucketing based on stable keys), integrate an audit-fingerprint for rollout events, and introduce a shadow-traffic permission scope so customers can grant deployments shadow-only exposure without promote rights. Deliverables: (1) SDK bucketing helper that hashes a namespace+stable_key to a deterministic bucket and supports sticky exposures across sessions; (2) server API changes to accept and store rollout audit_fingerprint, and an opt-in dry-run endpoint returning diffs; (3) RBAC scope `rollout:shadow-only` and policy enforcement in the control plane; (4) migration plan for clients with old SDKs (server-side fallback to routing policy).
comments: 2025-02-16 - Initial spike finished. Prototype uses HMAC-SHA256 with per-project salt for bucketing, stores seed version in rollout manifest.
2025-02-20 - Design review: PM requested explicit support for user and session stable keys; Design suggested exposing both a high-level 'StickySampler' and a low-level 'hashToBucket' primitive.
2025-02-24 - ENG feedback: concerns about latent CPU cost in JS SDK when hashing at high QPS; added benchmark tasks to comments and will add wasm fallback for heavy clients.
2025-02-27 - Security review requested: audit_fingerprint contains rollout config checksum and timestamp; security asked to ensure no PII is included — we will canonicalize config before hashing.
2025-03-01 - PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4892 - adds SDK helpers and server acceptance for audit_fingerprint. Needs perf testing and integration tests before merge.
notes: Key design choices: use HMAC with per-project salt to avoid cross-project collisions, include seed_version in rollout manifest so we can rotate hashing algorithm safely, and expose a dry-run API (POST /rollouts/:id/dry-run) that simulates traffic assignment and returns a small sample diff. For audit_fingerprint we canonicalize the rollout manifest (sorted keys, normalized floats) and compute SHA256; we persist fingerprint on rollout events and surface it in Console for fast traceability.
qa_plan: Unit tests for bucketing math, integration test against control-plane routing, end-to-end test where SDK marks exposures and server persists audit_fingerprint. Perf tests: JS SDK hashing benchmark at 500 RPS per instance; WASM fallback if CPU > threshold.
acceptance_criteria: SDK exposes StickySampler with stable API and tests demonstrating deterministic buckets across restarts
Control plane stores audit_fingerprint on rollout create/update events and shows fingerprint in Console rollout timeline
New RBAC role `rollout:shadow-only` prevents promote/publish but allows shadow attach; enforced in API and Console UI
Dry-run endpoint returns deterministic diff and is rate-limited; backward compatibility: server routes to server-side bucketing if client lacks SDK helper
